why: The degenerate 'fix' that satisfies every clear-the-board assertion at once by clearing unconditionally, and the reason the level-switch cases each carry a control that keeps ordinary play printing. Named as the control for `tread-trail-level-switch-inferred-from-round-tick`: a guard that always fires and a guard that never fires are both wrong, and a test suite that only ever checks 'is the board empty afterwards' cannot tell them apart.
killedBy: tread trails: round boundary and level switch does not clear a board that was never announced and never changed round
